items.title: BlueDelta Hackers Attacking Users of Widely Used Ukrainian Webmail and News Service
items.description: A new credential-harvesting campaign has been discovered targeting users of UKR.NET, a popular Ukrainian webmail and news platform. The attacks are linked to BlueDelta, a Russian state-sponsored hacker group also known as APT28, Fancy Bear, and Forest Blizzard. items.title: Apache Log4j Vulnerability Allow Attackers to Intercept Sensitive Log Data
items.description: Apache Logging Services has disclosed a critical security vulnerability in Log4j Core that exposes applications to potential interception of log data.
